body: function issueMapCommand(p,attack=false,append=false){if(commandBlocked()){mapCommandReason('当前不能下令');return}if(append)return appendOrder(p,attack);if(placement){placement=null;drag=null;mapCommandReason('已取消建造放置');return}let enemy=state.entities.find(e=>e.team===1&&e.hp>0&&dist(e,p)<e.r+9),escort=!enemy&&!attack?state.entities.find(e=>e.team===0&&e.hp>0&&defs[e.type].speed&&e.type!=='repair'&&dist(e,p)<e.r+9):null;if(!enemy&&!escort&&terrainObstacles().some(o=>dist(o,p)<o.r+20))return (mapCommandReason('岩石区域不能通行'),tell('岩石区域无法通行，请选择隘口或其他空地'));let factories=state.entities.filter(e=>selection.has(e.id)&&e.team===0&&e.type==='factory'&&!e.build),rallied=0;if(!enemy)factories.forEach(f=>{let goal=groundGoal({r:16},{x:clamp(p.x,20,WIDTH-20),y:clamp(p.y,20,HEIGHT-20)});if(goal){f.rally=goal;rallied++;acceptMapCommand(f,'工厂集结点')}});if(rallied)tell('工厂集结点已设置');else if(factories.length&&!enemy)tell('找不到安全集结点，保留原设置');let followed=0,guarded=0,assigned=0,oreIndex=!enemy&&!attack?state.ores.findIndex(o=>o.amount>0&&dist(o,p)<=32):-1;let troops=state.entities.filter(e=>selection.has(e.id)&&defs[e.type].speed&&e.team===0&&e.hp>0),spacing=orderSpacing(),used=[],groundPlans=new Map();if(!troops.length&&!factories.length){attackMode=false;return tell(state.entities.some(e=>selection.has(e.id)&&e.team===0&&e.hp>0&&e.type==='factory'&&e.build)?'工厂尚未完工，暂不能设置集结点':'先选择部队或工厂')}if(!enemy){let candidates=formationOrder(troops.filter(e=>!(oreIndex>=0&&e.type==='harvester')&&!(escort&&validEscort(e,escort)))),cols=Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(candidates.length)),rows=Math.ceil(candidates.length/(cols||1));for(let i=0;i<candidates.length;i++){let e=candidates[i],goal=groundGoal(e,{x:clamp(p.x+(i%cols-(cols-1)/2)*spacing,20,WIDTH-20),y:clamp(p.y+(Math.floor(i/cols)-(rows-1)/2)*spacing,20,HEIGHT-20)},used);if(goal){used.push({...goal,r:e.r});groundPlans.set(e.id,goal)}}}troops.forEach(e=>{if(oreIndex>=0&&e.type==='harvester'){assignOreOrder(e,oreIndex);assigned++;acceptMapCommand(e,'指定矿点');return}if(escort&&validEscort(e,escort)){navigationMemory.delete(e);clearPatrol(e);clearMoveQueue(e);clearGuardArea(e);clearAttackQueue(e);e.escortId=escort.id;e.target=null;e.goal=null;e.hold=false;e.attackMove=e.type!=='repair';if(e.type==='repair')followed++;else guarded++;acceptMapCommand(e,e.type==='repair'?'维修车跟随':'护航矿车');return}let goal=enemy?null:groundPlans.get(e.id);if(!enemy&&!goal)return;navigationMemory.delete(e);clearPatrol(e);clearMoveQueue(e);clearGuardArea(e);clearAttackQueue(e);e.escortId=null;e.hold=false;e.target=enemy?enemy.id:null;e.goal=goal;e.arrivalRadius=troops.length>1?clamp(e.r,5,16):5;e.attackMove=attack;e.manual=e.type==='harvester'?10:0;if(e.type==='harvester'){e.returnCargo=false;e.oreIndex=null}acceptMapCommand(e,enemy?(defs[e.type].damage?'指定攻击目标':'非战斗车目标记录（不代表攻击）'):(attack&&defs[e.type].damage?'攻击移动':'移动'))});if(followed)tell('维修车已跟随 '+defs[escort.type].name+'：优先维修跟随目标');if(guarded)tell(guarded+' 辆战斗车辆已护航采矿车，附近交战后继续跟随');if(assigned)tell(assigned+' 辆矿车已指定矿点，交付后会返回此处；S恢复自动选矿');if(!enemy&&used.length+followed+guarded+assigned<troops.length)tell('部分单位未找到安全落点，保留原命令');if(rallied||enemy&&troops.length||used.length||followed||guarded||assigned){drag=null;playSound('order')};pushEffect({x:p.x,y:p.y,t:.6,max:.6,type:'order'});attackMode=false}
